scope: Only three requested cable supplier families. Findings are bounded to accessible official text and the already-saved drawings; no claim of exhaustive official-document absence.

newly_confirmed.limits: Does not specify a complete cutter/deburr/liner/crimp procedure, final installed lengths, ferrule seating, clamp torque or minimum tail. Preserve factory-fixed ball end; no inference that arbitrary replacement cable/ends are equivalent.

requested_fields.needed_definition: Approved tightening torque/range for this M4 slotted screw, nickel-plated brass body and supplied Ø1.5 stainless core, including lubrication and reuse conditions.
requested_fields.not_a_substitute: Generic M4 bolt torque is not a cable-clamp torque; it can damage wire/brass and provides no slip-force assurance.

requested_fields.needed_definition: Minimum cable extension beyond the terminal wire-exit surface, with a clearly defined datum and any end treatment.
requested_fields.not_a_substitute: L7 is nipple axial body length and L1=3.5 locates the transverse hole; neither is wire-tail requirement.

requested_fields.needed_definition: Slip/pull-out limit or rated allowable force at stated torque, tail, core construction and load history, including repeat actuation if applicable.
requested_fields.not_a_substitute: The core material, nominal diameter and hole clearance do not establish clamp retention. Neither M4 thread capacity nor core breaking force alone supplies this rating.

requested_fields.needed_definition: Distance from adjuster inlet face to the actual loaded ferrule reaction datum, including mating nose/cone/chamfers and tolerances.
requested_fields.not_a_substitute: Ø7 straight-bore depth8.5 belongs to the adjuster, and the CAD shallow-boundary pose is not a measured loaded seat.03096-30 was not newly researched; only existing evidence was reused.

requested_fields.needed_definition: Final housing insertion/seat datum plus prescribed crimp tool/profile/force and post-crimp dimensions.
requested_fields.not_a_substitute: L1=9 describes the straight bore; L2=4.5 identifies crimp-zone location, not crimp depth or final compression.

current_candidate_geometric_tail_budget.interpretation: CAD installation maximum/space budget only, not a manufacturer minimum or validated holding-force condition.
current_candidate_geometric_tail_budget.conditional_gate: If the supplier-required external tail is larger than this nominal5.5 mm allowance, this exact packaging is incompatible and requires a separately reviewed change. Do not trim below a required tail merely to clear surrounding parts.

bounded_next_choices.next_evidence: Obtain an exact-part assembly specification with torque/tail/retention and seat/crimp data, or documented validation on the actual selected hardware/core assembly. No extra printed coupon is required by this report.
bounded_next_choices.current_action: Keep the force/seat gates open and leave final core trimming until the actual routed and seated assembly is established; do not issue invented setup values.

bounded_next_choices.next_evidence: Use a supplier-defined assembly that specifies terminal geometry, length datums and rated pull/retention performance; review its actual interfaces before substitution.
bounded_next_choices.current_action: This is an alternative evidence path, not a selected replacement product or permission to change CAD.
